【原视频简介】
There’s nothing better than turning what’s growing in the garden into dinner. 🌿 In this video, I’m sharing several simple **garden-fresh meal ideas** using produce picked right outside — including feta pasta, a fresh sausage skillet, bruschetta, and homemade garden pizza.

I’m also taking you back into the garden to show how our **Vego Garden raised beds** are growing this season and how adding irrigation has made keeping everything watered much easier for our busy family.

If you’re growing tomatoes, peppers, basil, or other summer produce and wondering what to make with your harvest, these are easy, family-friendly ways to get that garden goodness onto the table.
